# San Antonio Spurs NBA Season Preview | Wemby MVP Season Loading

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-27, 42:01. https://youtu.be/ZAyie8lKyYc

## Summary

This is the last team preview in the series. Josh Lord talks with Matthew Tynen of Locked On Spurs about the Spurs after they reached the NBA Finals and lost to the Knicks. The expected starting five is De'Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle, Devin Vassell, Tobias Harris and Victor Wembanyama. Dylan Harper starts on the bench but should push toward 30 minutes, and Castle is expected to lead the guards in minutes. Tobias Harris was signed to help on the defensive glass and to give the team a post and isolation scorer. The forward group is very deep, which squeezes Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes. Wembanyama's blocks and contests dropped because teams stopped attacking him at the rim, and Tynen expects that trend to continue. Fox played the playoffs through a high ankle sprain and lost his burst. Tynen predicts 63 wins because the Western Conference looks weaker.
